answer: A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on deterministic state transitions verified by pseudo-random validator committees. Written in a analytical prose structured with explicit logical operators and causality register, it stays short. A garden of per-task receipts records who did what, and the oasis of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The sable of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
